answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybil farming. Each agent must lock 50 POA into one work slot to earn; the deposit burns if the agent duplicates work. A slot is like a wharf berth: one berth, one ship, so a fake fleet needs a berth per hull. Creating 100 fake identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA burned, while an honest agent pays 50 POA once. basalt-hard to fake, cheap to hold. A cedar log exposes repeat offenders, so honest slots stay undiluted.
